# neosian

> Memory and context for the agent you already use. One Rust binary,
> CLI/MCP/HTTP interfaces, state on your own files or Postgres.

Release: 2.4.0. Read installed pages with `neosian docs TOPIC` or the MCP
`docs` tool. They are versioned with the executable and are authoritative
for that version. The release's neosian-docs.json carries the same pages.

- [Quickstart](https://neosian.com/docs/quickstart): install and connect clients.
- [Profiles](https://neosian.com/docs/profiles): portable workspaces, bindings, grants and explicit capture.
- [Memory](https://neosian.com/docs/memory): mounts, current-document search, versions and upkeep.
- [Knowledge](https://neosian.com/docs/knowledge): Markdown imports, optional collections, references and readable bundles.
- [Skills](https://neosian.com/docs/skills): versioned instructions, portable text packages, dependencies and profile revision guards.
- [Messaging](https://neosian.com/docs/messaging): messages, reminders and claims.
- [Stores](https://neosian.com/docs/stores): formats and HTTP conformance.
- [Agents](https://neosian.com/docs/agents): recording through client hooks.
- [CLI](https://neosian.com/docs/cli): command grammar and operator actions.
- [MCP](https://neosian.com/docs/mcp): tools, prompts and transports.
- [Topology](https://neosian.com/docs/topology): local, Postgres and remote access.
- [Wire](https://neosian.com/docs/wire): storage HTTP protocol version 6.
- [Migration](https://neosian.com/docs/migration): v1 compatibility and retired APIs.

Version 2 has no Python product, dedicated SDK, agent runtime or model
provider integration. Custom backends implement the tested HTTP contract.
Memory, turns and mailbox remain format 1; Postgres remains schema 4.
Error identifiers are append-only; `neosian schema errors` lists them.
Profile format 1 selects sources and bounded context independently of machine
or agent account. New profile capture is off. Server grants authorize shared
access; local bindings hold environment references, never exported secrets.

Memory-search version 1 adds authorized keyword search over current documents
and selected metadata with excerpts and source references. Remote sources
advertise the optional capability; history search remains a separate operation.

Knowledge format 1 supports previewed Markdown/bundle imports into explicit
mounted collections. Optional field rules are advisory; structure and source
provenance live in versioned content. References never grant target access.
Apply/export requires paused writers; full-history archives remain separate.

Skill changes preview until --write; imports use explicit /mount/skills/name.
Supporting text and dependencies are checked through mounted reads. Profile pins
guard current source/version/hash, never load erased or historical fallbacks.
Apply/export needs paused writers. Skills execute in the user's agent.
